name: origin-ui-label
blurb: Form label with theme tokens and peer-disabled state styling.
description: A wrapper around Radix UI's label primitive with semantic sizing, theme token colors, and dual disabled-state support via peer and group-data selectors.
use_when: Labeling form inputs in a design system using theme tokens.
avoid_when: For non-form text — use plain typography components instead.
a11y: Native HTML label with htmlFor support. Respects both peer-disabled and group-data-[disabled] states for accessibility.
